description: Debug a timezone conversion bug in a meeting scheduling application. The bug: meetings scheduled by East Coast users appear at wrong times for West Coast users. Your task: (1) Open workspace at /home/ga/workspace/meeting-scheduler/, (2) Examine the code in utils/dateConverter.js which contains a localToUTC function that converts local time strings to UTC timestamps, (3) Run test/timezone-bug.js to see the bug (you can use 'npm test' or run the file directly), (4) Use VSCode debugger to step through the code and inspect date values - the bug involves applying timezone offset conversion twice, (5) Find the specific line in the localToUTC function where double timezone conversion occurs (hint: moment.tz() already handles timezone, but the code manually adjusts offset again), (6) Add a comment on or near that line marking it as a bug (use BUG, TODO, FIXME, or similar marker text), (7) Save the file. The problematic code is around the utcOffset calculation where 'localMoment.valueOf() - (utcOffset * 60 * 1000)' is performed.
